lines.text: Six weeks since the ACL reconstruction. How's it been since last time?
Since last time I've stopped using the crutches completely.
From last time the evening swelling has gone down, I'm fairly sure.
Let me have a look. You can get it fully straight now and bend to 120 degrees, and the quads are firing well.
Sorry, I meant to ask, when can I get back on my bike?
Static bike from now, no resistance to start with, and road cycling not before twelve weeks.
Also no running for now, that's the big one.
Okay. See you next week then.
